revival_heights_logger.name: Bjarke
pages:
Look, I need logs. Logs come from
trees. That's just how logs work.

(The Topiarix plants itself in front
of the last tree. Leaves everywhere.)

It's ONE tree. You're a shrub.
Why do you even care?

(It drops a twig on his boot.
On purpose. Probably.)

Fine! FINE. One cut, one sapling.
I'll plant a new one for each.
after:
Two saplings in today. The Kilu
still won't talk to me. Rude.

pages:
(A Topiarix stands guard in front
of the last tree. It rustles at you.)

(It points a branch at the logger.
It seems to want a witness.)
after:
(The Topiarix guards a neat row of
saplings. It rustles proudly.)

pages:
Hop, hop, skip! You can't step on
the garden patch. That's the rule.
I made the rule. It's a good rule.

He only comes out for snacks.
I don't have snacks. Do you?
